name: ANSI four-input NAND gate
summary: Four-input D-shaped NAND gate with an output bubble; its output goes low only when all four inputs are high.
description: A four-input NAND gate is drawn with the AND outline, four input leads and a bubble at the output. The output is low only when every input is high. The function is supplied by dual four-input NAND packages and is a common building block for address decoding and multi-condition alarms.

Where some inputs are active low in the design intent, the drawing may show the same device in its De Morgan form as an OR outline with bubbled inputs. Either representation is valid, but the chosen form should match the meaning of the signals so that the sheet reads naturally.
The symbol alone does not show which package or gate section is used. Reference designators and pin numbers come from the device schedule.
readingNotes: Check for the output bubble; without it the gate is an AND.
Consider whether an equivalent OR form is used elsewhere for the same device.
drawingChecklist: Add the gate section and pin numbers when used for wiring.
distinction: An OR outline with bubbled inputs is the De Morgan equivalent of the same NAND function.
